meta.source: generated entirely from installed game resources; no save-derived records
meta.generatedBy: rebuild-map-points.mjs over an unpacked game content directory
meta.markerRule: Dungeon -> 8, Rift -> 9, otherwise -> 7 (verified 126/126 against the completed save)
limitations: Location is the guidance-network node position, not the runtime door actor transform; save coordinates differ by 50-unit grid steps in X/Y and ~92/100 in Z
HasOptionalDoorMarkerOverride / OptionalDoorMarkerType have no per-door native table, so all bundled records use false / 0
68 of the 251 ids are alternative spawn spots of procedural dungeon/rift groups; DT_ProceduralAreas.json uses UseFixedSeeds=false and opens only a subset per session
DT_CutsceneDefinition uses SW.UI.cutscene.Miniscene.MS49 while the game writes SW.UI.Cutscene.Miniscene.MS49 into saves; bundled list keeps the native spelling
